europe_now.title: US-Led Peace Talks and High-Level Diplomatic Meetings
europe_now.summary: United States envoys have arrived in Russia and are scheduled to meet with regional leaders following discussions held in Abu Dhabi. The diplomatic engagements focus on addressing ongoing conflicts and pursuing potential pathways toward a negotiated settlement.

europe_now.title: General Strike and Large-Scale Protests in Spain
europe_now.summary: Tens of thousands of people have taken to the streets in Spain as part of a general strike centered around housing concerns. The demonstrations have resulted in significant public mobilization and reported clashes in cities such as Barcelona.

top_stories.title: Regional Security and Hybrid Threats
top_stories.summary: European leaders have gathered in Dublin to discuss pressing security challenges amid rising concerns regarding hybrid threats. Officials are assessing strategies to bolster collective defense and protect critical infrastructure across the continent.

top_stories.title: School Disruptions Caused by Bomb Threats
top_stories.summary: Educational institutions across multiple European countries, including Italy, Ireland, and the United Kingdom, have experienced widespread evacuations. These disruptions followed a wave of coordinated bomb threats targeting schools in the region.

europe_now.title: School Bomb Threats Across Europe
europe_now.summary: Multiple bomb threats have disrupted hundreds of schools across Italy, Ireland, and the United Kingdom, leading to widespread evacuations. Authorities are actively responding to the security incidents.

europe_now.summary: Tens of thousands of demonstrators participated in a general strike across Spain, focusing on housing concerns and economic pressures. Clashes erupted in major cities like Barcelona as crowds gathered for the protests.

top_stories.summary: US envoys are scheduled to meet with Russian and Ukrainian leadership following recent talks in Abu Dhabi. Meanwhile, representatives have agreed to a major prisoner exchange as diplomatic discussions continue.

top_stories.summary: Tens of thousands of people attended a nationalist march in Poland just days after a series of shootings. The large public gathering proceeded under heightened domestic security monitoring.
